newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania tennis star Nastase to run for parliament.
newsitem.headline: Romania tennis star Nastase to run for parliament.

text.p: Ilie Nastase, the ex-tennis star who failed to win the post of Bucharest mayor in June, will stand for parliament for Romania's ruling leftist party in November's elections, a party official said on Thursday.
"Nastase has been designated by the party leadership to run for deputy in Harghita county," Dan Ghibernea, a spokesman for the Party of Social Democracy (PDSR), told Reuters.
The Transylvanian county of Harghita is home to ethnic Hungarians whose political allegiances go to the Hungarian Democratic Union, a party representing the country's 1.6 million ethnic Hungarians.
"Nastase could open virgin territory to the PDSR," Ghibernea said, adding that his party hoped Nastase would win 75 percent of votes in Harghita in the elections on November 3.
The PDSR, hoping that the one-time winner of the French Open tennis title would revive its battered image, picked Nastase as its candidate in the mayoral election in Bucharest in June.
But he lost to Victor Ciorbea, a sombre union leader of the main opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) group.

The PDSR fared poorly in June's municipal ballot, seen as a test ahead of parliamentary and presidential polls. Latest opinion polls give the CDR a 33 percent lead, followed by the PDSR with 29 percent.
